behavior =
  ! foil
  + field
    \ key=str value=json
    ^ json
    ?> (json/obj fields) value jnull
    = found fields.keep((\ entry (eq entry.k key)))
    ? (eq found.len 1) found.at(0).v jnull
  + text
    \ key=str value=json
    ^ str
    ?> (json/str text) (behavior/field key value) ""
    text
  + ordinal
    \ date=str
    ^ maybe[nat]
    ? !(eq date.len 10) .none
    < year (nat/parse date.slice(0 4))
    < month (nat/parse date.slice(5 2))
    < day (nat/parse date.slice(8 2))
    ? ((eq year 0) || (eq month 0) || (gt month 12) || (eq day 0)) .none
    = prior year.dec
      leap (and (eq (mod year 4) 0) (!(eq (mod year 100) 0) || (eq (mod year 400) 0)))
      lengths=row[nat] [31 (? leap 29 28) 31 30 31 30 31 31 30 31 30 31]
    ? (gt day lengths.at(month.dec)) .none
    = elapsed (add (sub (add (mul prior 365) (div prior 4)) (div prior 100)) (div prior 400))
    % i=nat 0 days=nat elapsed
    ^ maybe[nat]
    ? (eq i month.dec) (./some (add days day))
    | _ i.inc (add days lengths.at(i))
  + interval
    \ row=json
    ^ maybe[[nat nat]]
    < start (behavior/ordinal (behavior/text "start" row))
    = end_date (behavior/text "end" row)
    ? !(eq end_date "")
      < end (behavior/ordinal end_date)
      ? (lt end start) .none
      | ./some [start end]
    < duration (nat/parse (behavior/text "duration" row))
    | ./some [start (add start duration)]
  + conflict
    \ a=json b=json
    ^ bool
    ? (eq (behavior/text "id" a) (behavior/text "id" b)) .false
    ? !(eq (behavior/text "lane" a) (behavior/text "lane" b)) .false
    ?> (./some left) (behavior/interval a) .false
    ?> (./some right) (behavior/interval b) .false
    = [start end] left [other_start other_end] right
    | and (and (lt start end) (lt other_start other_end)) (and (lt start other_end) (lt other_start end))
  + apply
    \ input=json
    ^ either[str json]
    ? (equal[json] input jnull) (./ok (json/boo .true))
    ?> (json/arr rows) (behavior/field "rows" input) (./err "Expected current records")
    = changed (behavior/text "changed" input)
      selected rows.keep((\ row (eq (behavior/text "id" row) changed)))
    ? !(eq selected.len 1) (./err "The changed record is missing")
    ?> (./some interval) (behavior/interval selected.at(0)) (./err "An interval needs a valid date and duration")
    | ./ok (json/boo !(rows.any((behavior/conflict selected.at(0)))))
